answer: A Sybil-resilient AI economy can leverage hardware-bound attestation, requiring each agent to prove ownership of a scarce digital relic, such as a secure enclave key, to operate. This relic makes mass identity fabrication prohibitively expensive, unlike a hollow credential that effortlessly spawns unlimited agents. By embedding this computational cost into the execution environment, the system ensures that every agent on the decentralized island represents a unique, economically accountable actor rather than a synthetic duplicate.
